statewideTerm: The Governor and Lieutenant Governor serve four-year terms ending in January 2027; those elected on November 3, 2026 take office then. The Attorney General, Treasurer and Auditor General were elected in 2024 for terms ending in January 2029. The Secretary of the Commonwealth is appointed.

notes.election: A general election was held on November 3, 2026. This roster lists officials in office on the build date; people elected on November 3 take office in January 2027 and are not shown yet.
